description: ALPHA - early test release, feedback wanted. Made with a lot of help from AI: most of the code and documentation was written by an AI assistant (Claude), directed and tested in game by LondoSpark. Run-around / run round / runaround for locomotives: instead of the game's instant flip at a terminus, the loco uncouples, runs around its train along a loop, headshunt or wye you pick on the map, and couples on at the other end, with its own sound, smoke, wheels and paint. Set up in the train window; see the README.
name: Runaround Railways (ALPHA)
summary: ALPHA, made with a lot of help from AI. Your loco runs around its train at the terminus instead of the instant flip. Click a few points on the track: it uncouples, runs around with its own sound, smoke and paint, and couples on at the other end.
